results.title: Summary of EV related US Tariffs on Chinese Imports
results.content:
Tariffs on EVs under Section 301 will rise from 25% to 100% in 2024.
 This tariff increase aims to protect American manufacturers from unfair trade practices and safeguard investments and jobs in the EV sector.
 The tariffs are aimed at ensuring a “made in America by American workers” future.

## Batteries: [...] ## Batteries:

 China controls >80% of certain segments of the EV battery supply chain, seen as a risk to U.S. supply chains and national security.
 Tariffs on lithium-ion EV batteries will rise from 7.5% to 25% in 2024
 Natural graphite will face tariffs of 25%, as will permanent magnets, starting 2026. Other critical minerals will have the same tariffs, starting even earlier – this year.

## Other Tariffs [...] ## Closing Remarks

Tariffs are meant to increase prices of and discourage imports, which in this case is seemingly at odds with the U.S. goal of accelerating decarbonization and addressing climate change. References to national security notwithstanding, ultimately these tariffs are about protecting jobs (especially in an election year).
